responsibility: Collects exported function prototypes for the SPU backend and frontend-support code. It declares the C preprocessor hooks, prologue/epilogue and calling-convention helpers, immediate and constant classification routines, address and move splitters, builtin expanders and overloaded-builtin resolver, vector helper expanders, atomic expansion helpers, and printing interfaces that are shared across spu.c, spu-c.c, and the generated machine description support code.
